bsc/matxa-ca-multispeaker-wavenext.description: Catalan multispeaker Matcha-TTS, end-to-end with a fused Wavenext vocoder (single ONNX, no separate vocoder). 47 speakers (Festcat + OpenSLR69), 22.05kHz. Vocab/tokenizer alignment with phoonnx pending validation.

bsc/matxa-ca-multispeaker-hifigan.description: Catalan multispeaker Matcha-TTS, end-to-end with a fused HiFi-GAN vocoder (single ONNX). 47 speakers, 22.05kHz. Vocab/tokenizer alignment with phoonnx pending validation.

bsc/matxa-ca-multispeaker-vocos.description: Catalan multispeaker Matcha-TTS, two-stage: acoustic mel model + the separate alVoCat (Vocos) ISTFT vocoder. Non-commercial vocoder license. 47 speakers, 22.05kHz. Vocab/tokenizer alignment with phoonnx pending validation.

bsc/matxa-ca-multiaccent-wavenext.description: Catalan multiaccent Matcha-TTS, end-to-end with a fused Wavenext vocoder. 8 speakers across 4 dialects (Balear/Central/Nord-Occidental/Valencian); dialect-specific cleaners apply. 22.05kHz. Vocab/tokenizer alignment with phoonnx pending validation.

bsc/matxa-ca-central-graphemes-v2.description: Catalan Central v2 Matcha-TTS working from graphemes (no phonemes: pass-through graphemes/unicode phonemizer, char->id handled by the tokenizer), end-to-end with a fused Wavenext vocoder. Improved ScoreQ/WER/CER over v1; stratified-sampling + cosine timestep schedule + spectrogram denoiser. 22.05kHz. Tokenizer (char) vocab alignment with phoonnx pending validation.
